ننتفض (form VIII)
# نَنْتَفِضُ (nantafiḍu) /nan.ta.fi.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَفَضَ (intafaḍa)
# نَنْتَفِضَ (nantafiḍa) /nan.ta.fi.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَفَضَ (intafaḍa)
# نَنْتَفِضْ (nantafiḍ) /nan.ta.fidˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْتَفَضَ (intafaḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
